# unifi_access_holiday_group (Data Source)

Look up a UniFi Access holiday group by `id` (`unique_id`) or `name` (read-only). **Modeled from the undocumented Access API and not yet verified against a live console — see the provider TODO.**



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Access object id (`unique_id`). Provide `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Holiday group display name. Provide `name` or `id`. If multiple groups share a name, the first match wins.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) Creation timestamp, RFC3339.
- `description` (String) Holiday group description.
- `holiday_count` (Number) Number of member holidays.
- `holiday_ids` (Set of String) Member holiday ids (`unique_id` of each holiday).
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default holiday group.
- `is_private` (Boolean) Whether the group is private to its creator.
- `template_name` (String) Template the group was seeded from, if any.
